At the same time, frontend and checkoutservice p90 latency increase, and both depend on currencyservice. This is the strongest signal linking the degradation to a shared dependency.

The frontend’s “failed to retrieve ads” messages are worth investigating, but adservice shows no sustained resource or latency anomaly and does not explain checkoutservice’s rising latency.
